say:1:1062303001:1.source_cn: 艾雅在上，您解决魔偶的身姿真是令人目眩！

say:2:1062303002:1.text: Thanks to you, our camp is safe, and everyone's feeling a whole lot more at ease.
say:2:1062303002:1.source_cn: 多亏了您，我们的营地终于安全了，大家都松了一口气呢。
say:2:1062303002:1.male: Thanks to you, our camp is safe, and everyone's feeling a whole lot more at ease.
say:2:1062303002:1.female: Thanks to you, our camp is safe, and everyone's feeling a whole lot more at ease.

say:3:1062303003:1.text: Please accept this small gift as a token of our appreciation. Thanks again!
say:3:1062303003:1.source_cn: 请您收下我们的礼物吧。再次感谢您！
